name: 044.1 — a widget drawn into a texture, standing in the world
author: brodgar
description: Self-checking suite for task 044.1: hafen.vr():widget():add(w, p) stands one of your own widgets in the 3D world — its Draw still fires, it leaves the flat UI's hit-testing while staying in the tree, it redraws only when what it shows changed, and 026's text cache is still hit from the offscreen GOut.
